name: ARC-630 Flagship MMA Welder 630A

images.alt: GOWELLDE ARC-630 flagship 630A MMA welding machine

summary: 630A flagship stick welder — the top of the GOWELLDE MMA range.
description: The ARC-630 tops the MMA range with 630A output from a 2×G150N120 IGBT stage and the T130 transformer. For preheating, thick-section structural work and carbon-arc gouging duty, it is the machine heavy fabricators specify when nothing smaller survives the shift.
